# Public KeePass interoperability fixtures

These base64-encoded test databases and key files come from the MIT-licensed
KPassLib repository, pinned to commit
`81d51d9f3575f72136441ea5a271f6748e3ca77c`:

<https://github.com/vladimir-skorokhodov/kpasslib/tree/81d51d9f3575f72136441ea5a271f6748e3ca77c/assets/test>

The upstream MIT copyright notice is in `packages/kpasslib/LICENSE`.
The source files are unchanged; base64 is only a transport representation.
These are public demonstration credentials, not user databases.

- `demo`, `argon2id`, `argon2ChaCha`: password `demo` and `demo.key`.
- `key32`, `key64`: password `test` and the corresponding key file.
- `keyV2`, `noPassWithKeyFile`: key file only, without a password component.
- `kdbx4.1`: password `test` (upstream test).

Fixtures contain data created by KeePass, providing interoperability evidence
beyond databases generated by CrispCloud's own save implementation.
